messages:
Priya: Quick check — we're going to enable streaming debug traces for ~1% of LLM requests to diagnose a tail-latency bug. Before we flip this on: what exactly should we redact from the streaming payloads? thinking: full prompt, response tokens, auth headers, and any PII in headers/bodies. any objections?

Alex: +1 on being conservative. streaming traces are dangerous because they can capture tokens mid-generation. we should never log raw tokens.

Dan: Agreed. Minimal telemetry idea: capture event-level metadata (model, seq_len, total_tokens, sampling_params) + masked prompt fingerprint (hash) and response length. No raw prompt/response strings unless explicitly approved.

Priya: sgtm. For debugging, sometimes we need short prompt snippets to reproduce. propose: allow storing a truncated prompt snippet (first 120 chars) but mask any email/phone patterns and remove bearer tokens. Also tie access to an approval ticket.

Alex: If we do snippets, enforce strong redaction rules and storage TTL (24h). Also require that snippet storage is opt-in per-customer and logged in audit trail.

Dan: +1. Also: for headers, redact Authorization, Cookie, X-User-Email, X-Api-Key by default. We can keep header names and presence flags but not values.

Priya: drafting regex rules — please sanity-check:
```
# header rules
Authorization: replace with REDACTED_AUTH
Cookie: REDACTED_COOKIE
X-Api-Key: REDACTED_KEY
X-User-Email: REDACTED_EMAIL

# body/prompt rules
# 1) mask emails: /[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/ -> <EMAIL>
# 2) mask phones: /(\+?\d[\d \-()]{7,}\d)/ -> <PHONE>
# 3) mask tokens: /(eyJ[0-9A-Za-z_-]{10,})/ -> <JWT>
# 4) truncate long strings: keep first 120 chars + "..." if longer
```

Alex: those look good as a starting point. For (3) token regex, add common patterns for Bearer and API key formats. Also, do not log KV cache contents or internal embeddings.

Priya: noted — we'll add rules to completely omit kv_cache fields from streaming traces.

Logbot: Deploy-checklist: streaming-traces feature flag gated, redact rules loaded from central config, retention=24h, access requires "eng-security" approval + ticket ref, audit events emitted.

Dan: One more: for hashed prompt fingerprints, use HMAC-SHA256 with service key so it's not reversible. store fingerprint + salt_version. That lets devs correlate repeats without exposing content.

Priya: good call. I'll add HMAC fingerprinting and a short doc snippet for on-call: how to request access (link to runbook + required justification).

Alex: please add a monitoring alert if sensitive patterns are detected in logs (post-redaction). i.e., if regex matches anything that we failed to redact, send a P1 to eng-security channel.

Priya: will do. plan: implement rules, run a local audit job on sample traffic, then enable 1% with feature flag and review after 48h. tagging @Dan @Alex for final sign-off — can you ack so I can open the PR and the security ticket? :thumbsup:

Dan: ack. :thumbsup:

Alex: ack. small nits addressed in PR comments later.

Priya: thanks — opening PR + ticket now. will paste links in this thread when ready.

Logbot: PR created: PR #2421 by Priya for streaming-traces redaction rules (link). Ticket: SEC-5890 created and assigned to Priya.
